request.prompt: Use the Makaron Spark + Pixel Wizard reference sheet for brand identity. Spark is Makaron's creative source and editing signature: magenta/cyan energy that emerges from the product UI and shows transformation. Pixel Wizard is Makaron's small purple bubble-ghost mascot and the mischievous, slightly scared guide/personification of Spark. Pixel Wizard must actively interact with Spark using his whole squishy body, not simply hold a magic wand. Avoid making Spark just a wand glow. The mascot is a sidekick, not the protagonist. Create ONE polished square advertising scene, not a contact sheet. Cream background, central smartphone showing a landscape photo editing interface; a magenta/cyan Spark ribbon emerges from the phone and transforms a gray photo into a colorful forest. Pixel Wizard, 20% of the composition, clings nervously to this ribbon with his whole squishy body; preserve the exact purple translucent ghost shape, pixel face and floppy dark-purple hat from the sheet. Soft studio lighting, integrated shadows, premium 3D material. Heading at top: MAKARON. No other text.
